name: Citizenship by Descent

qualifying_event.description: A child acquires Latvian citizenship automatically if both parents, or one parent, are Latvian citizens at the time of birth (Citizenship Law, Article 2, Section 1(2), subject to Article 9's conditions). A child born after 21 August 1991 to stateless or non-citizen parents may also acquire citizenship if a parent holds permanent residence in Latvia (Article 3.1).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; proof of parent(s)' Latvian citizenship or permanent residence status.

requirement_groups.name: One or both parents are Latvian citizens

requirements.blocker_text: At least one parent is a Latvian citizen at the time of the child's birth.

requirement_groups.name: Born after 21 August 1991 to a stateless/non-citizen parent with permanent residence

requirements.blocker_text: Born after 21 August 1991 to a stateless or non-citizen parent who holds permanent residence in Latvia.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parent(s)' Latvian citizenship or permanent-resident/non-citizen status

sources.title: likumi.lv (Latvia's official legal database) -- Citizenship Law, Article 2 Section 1(2): citizenship by birth to a Latvian-citizen parent; Article 3.1: citizenship for children born after 21 August 1991 to a stateless/non-citizen parent with permanent residence in Latvia

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Latvia). Article 3.1's post-1991 provision is a direct legacy of Latvia's specific post-Soviet citizenship history: it addresses children of the country's large 'non-citizen' (nepilsoni) population -- Soviet-era settlers and their descendants who were not automatically granted citizenship upon independence -- giving THEIR children a route to citizenship where the parent holds permanent residence, distinct from ordinary descent-from-a-citizen. This is a narrower, more historically specific descent framework than Peru's third-generation window or Lithuania's simplified-descent route; no broader 'Latvian-origin diaspora' citizenship-by-option route for adult descendants was found in this pass.
